name: model-pear
title: Software Transaction Structuring Tool
description: Find optimal pricing and compare transaction structures for South African B2B software companies.
audience: Founders, sales leads, and finance teams at South African B2B software companies who need to price a deal that works for both sides.
useCases: A founder is quoting a new enterprise client — models a per-seat vs revenue-share structure to find which one hits 40% margin while keeping the client’s ROI above 2x
A sales team is losing deals on price — compares 47 pricing variants side by side to find structures where the headline price is lower but lifetime value is higher
A finance lead needs to present pricing options to the board — runs three deal scenarios and shows exactly where each one breaks even
A startup is negotiating with a large retailer — models a transaction-fee structure where the client pays nothing upfront and the vendor earns on volume

dataPrivacy.storage: All calculations run in the browser. No data is stored or sent anywhere.
